p4.behavior: no-bucket-normal-pace는 직접 사례 미실행(페이싱 인라인 테스트 있음). per-command-cap/cap-ceiling 및 limit/deadline 동시 소진 사례는 S2에 따라 P4 재작성.

about: Per-operation limits and pacing (appendix A 30, 34 and plan X4). The guard knows operation names and header values, never X code. A bucket is {limit, remaining, reset} for one operation, from the last response that carried all three headers; reset is Unix seconds. now is the guard's clock. Pacing: every request waits 1-2 s at random after the previous one; when remaining falls below 20% of limit the gap stretches to (reset - now) / remaining; at 0 the bucket refuses until reset; a 429 sets remaining 0 and, when the reset is unknown or past, reset = now + 900. A bucket whose reset has passed is forgotten. Other operations are not affected. The command has one deadline (monotonic); a wait that would end after it is not started. The next allowed time (when the next request of this operation may go) and the bucket's reset are told apart in every message. source: code (previous budget.py), measured (planning session limits per 15 minutes: UserTweets 50, SearchTimeline 50, TweetDetail 300, HomeTimeline 500, Viewer 100), plan (X4: 1-2 s pacing, no 10-minute account window, deadline).

cases.name: low-bucket-stretches
cases.fact: Below 20% the gap is (reset - now) / remaining: 50 limit, 5 left, 300 s to reset → 60 s between requests.

cases.name: stretched-wait-past-deadline
cases.fact: When the stretched wait would end after the command's deadline the request is not started: a rate_limited stop whose next allowed time is now + 60 and whose bucket reset is 1300.

cases.name: other-operation-unaffected
cases.fact: An empty SearchTimeline bucket does not stop TweetDetail.

cases.name: no-account-window
cases.fact: The previous 200-requests-per-10-minutes account window is gone; only X's own per-operation limits, pacing and the per-command cap remain.

cases.name: per-command-cap
cases.fact: --max-requests defaults to 25 and may be raised to 400; a read that needs more stops as budget (resumable).

cases.name: limit-and-deadline-limit-first
cases.fact: Both apply but the limit stopped the next request first: its next allowed time (now + 60) falls after the deadline (now + 30), so the stop is rate_limited — 10 before any result.

cases.name: limit-and-deadline-past-deadline
cases.fact: Once the deadline has passed, the limit is not weighed again: the stop is time_limit (6 before any result) even though the bucket is also low.
